Details & attraction explanation: Hotel Monterey Kyoto. Relaxed breakfast before a long walking day.
Most efficient transfer for six people. Go directly to the kimono shop rather than spending time on buses.
Mimosa Higashiyama. Kimono selection, dressing and optional hairstyling. Confirm six people can be handled together and whether an 08:30 start is possible.

Activity: Ichinenzaka to Yasaka Pagoda to Ninenzaka to Sannenzaka
Details & attraction explanation: One of Kyoto's most beautiful historic areas. Traditional streets and the classic Yasaka Pagoda view make this the main kimono photography section. Don't rush it.
One of Kyoto's landmark temples, famous for its large wooden terrace and city views. Excellent setting for photos in kimono.
Return through the historic streets. Treat this as part of the experience rather than simply a transfer. More opportunities for photos.
Change into normal clothes and comfortable walking shoes for the afternoon.
Reserve around the Kodai-ji/Higashiyama area so lunch fits naturally into the route without requiring another taxi.
Attractive Zen temple with landscaped gardens and a hillside setting. More peaceful than the busy Kiyomizu area and a nice change of atmosphere.
Beautiful preserved lanes with traditional Kyoto architecture. This works particularly well as an atmospheric walking route toward Gion.
Go directly to Kennin-ji rather than adding another stop. This protects you against its earlier closing time.
Important Zen temple with gardens, traditional interiors and art. This is the afternoon stop whose timing I would protect.
Walk through the traditional heart of Gion as the afternoon light begins to fade. The walk itself is part of the sightseeing.
Very atmospheric Gion area with canal, small bridges and traditional machiya buildings. Particularly pleasant around dusk.
Major Shinto shrine at the eastern end of Gion. Evening gives it a different atmosphere from the daytime sightseeing.
Walk through the increasingly lively evening atmosphere toward central Kyoto and Pontocho.
Intentional buffer for a coffee, drink, sake or Kamo River stroll. Also absorbs delays earlier in the day without affecting dinner.
Find the restaurant and arrive comfortably before the reservation.
Excellent finish to the day. Reserve a good Japanese restaurant for all six.
I'd probably take two taxis after this much walking. If everyone still feels energetic, walking back is also reasonable.
